whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: This demonstration is basically comprised of several video clips showing you the nature of the projection apparatus. Images that are projected are video images combined with holographic images that are projected onto a spherical mirror which re-projects the images into a theater environment. This is a close-up of the video, plus some holographic elements that are included. And you can see that the colors are muted and any spherical aberration that you detect is due to the optics, whether or not it be mirrors or lenses. You can see that when the image is inverted, and this is a close-up of the projection gate with masks, that the inverted image will be corrected. In a parabolic reflection, which flips the image right side up and left to right. And you can see that the image is already depicted. And you can see that the image is already depicted.
